cohort: Laboring individuals with singleton pregnancies at a tertiary center between January 2013 and December 2022, who were at >=34 weeks gestational age, excluding those with major fetal anomalies, stillbirths, or missing delivery records.
finding: Intrapartum amnioinfusion was not associated with a reduction in the rate of postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) but was associated with a higher likelihood of infectious morbidity (endometritis and postpartum fever).
mod_finding: Individuals who received amnioinfusion had a higher cesarean rate (36.9%) compared to those who did not (9.5%).
